title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
summary: The East Coast's weather is a major concern this holiday, as it could lead to coastal flooding. And, the judge says the FCC can't punish ABC for satire Trump doesn't like.

title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.
content: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets. (Image credit: Heather Diehl/Thibault Camus/Pool)

title: Court lets Puerto Rico governor fire firm that runs the island's troubled power grid
